text: Port Ansgar — Kestrelline Rail will build its new maintenance depot in Port Ansgar, according to people familiar with the matter. The company has selected a 42-acre site on the city’s eastern freight corridor and plans to begin preparatory work in early March, the people said. The facility is expected to include six service bays, a wheel lathe and a training annex, with completion targeted for late 2027. Local officials have been briefed on the project, which is forecast to create about 180 jobs during construction and 64 permanent positions. Kestrelline did not immediately comment on the timetable or cost, which one person said is likely to exceed 110 million crowns.
